hypothesis: External collection source and response length confound author identity; source-balanced training may transfer better to unseen host prompts.
kind: exploratory data-selection pilot, not a v16 OOF comparison
license: CC BY-SA 4.0; credit Nishant Dahal and original pool contributors
promotion: At least 0.01 accuracy above uniform_pool on pilot fold, then evaluate all five folds and related-prompt folds in a separately recorded confirmation. Pilot alone never authorizes submission.
limitations: Existing development folds have been inspected repeatedly.
Normalized exact duplicates are removed; topical near-overlap remains an audit item.
Small capped pool and reduced sparse features are screening tools, not the complete v16 recipe.
No comparison to in-sample predictions of public fine-tuned models is allowed.
